examples.name: Distribution
examples.code:
<Distribution
  values={[
    { value: 50, color: 'light-3' },
    { value: 30, color: 'brand' },
    { value: 20, color: 'graph-0' },
    { value: 10, color: 'light-3' },
    { value: 5, color: 'brand' },
  ]}
>
  {value => (
    <Box pad="small" background={value.color} fill>
      <Text size="large">{value.value}</Text>
    </Box>
  )}
</Distribution>

prose.title: React/DOM Properties
prose.text:
At its core, the Distribution component is a regular <div> element. Thus, both DOM and React properties, methods, and events are accessible. To read up on all of the possible DOM attributes and types available for div elements, check out this [MDN Web Documents page.](https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/HTML/Element/div) To learn more about DOM events and methods, you can read more on the [MDN Web Events documentation page](https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/Events).

Also, feel free to read about the [types of React events available](https://reactjs.org/docs/handling-events.html), or see [how DOM attributes change in React.](https://reactjs.org/docs/dom-elements.html) Working in tandem with Styled Components, you also have access to the [as property.](https://styled-components.com/docs/api#as-polymorphic-prop)
